native.command: cargo test -p clubscape-game-types -p clubscape-simulation -p clubscape-world-engine -p clubscape-content -p clubscape-protocol -p clubscape-server -p clubscape-client-core --all-targets --quiet

canonical_engine_ui_probes.scope: Real unmodified source content and engine on controlled component preconditions; not a fresh journey.

required_asset_publication.policy: Publish and validate original source assets, then regenerate. No null icons, substituted models, removed source outcomes or relaxed startup checks.

caller_contract.input: WorldInput.ui / GameplayUiIntent; ordinary operation UUID and contiguous sequence
caller_contract.production_target: Option<WorldTarget> / WorldTarget|null; absent protobuf target for genuine inventory-only production
caller_contract.inventory_production: UseItem on an inventory slot opens a source menu. Trusted typed selection retains both slots/stacks/instances through selection and first completion; stale identities cannot consume another matching copy.
caller_contract.bank_precondition: GameplayUiRequest.expected_bank_revision must echo ui.bank.revision as a decimal string; validated after duplicate receipt lookup
caller_contract.migration: Stop the coordinator; configure a complete target game root; cargo run --locked -p clubscape-server -- migrate-ui --from <exact-old-raw-artifact-sha256>
caller_contract.preserved: Items, XP, entitlements, clocks, sequences, private RNG, acknowledged receipts, account-only mode, renderer/audio ABI and unchanged source gameplay checkpoints.
